title: What a business type is called and how it lists what it sells (jobs contract 1.1, part 1: sell_style W1, plural_names T2)
description: packages/packs/<id>/identity.json sits next to pack.json. It holds the two words of a business type that the Jobs screens and What you sell need: `sell_style` (which of the five lists the shop fills in) and `plural_names` (a short plural noun phrase for a sentence like 'ideas from other saree shops'). They are NOT in pack.json on purpose: a synced pack version is never edited (a changed pack.json needs a new pack version and a migration), and these words change without touching a module, a rule or a workspace's pinned pack. Code reads them by the pack id the database gives; it never names a pack. Checked in CI by services/ai-api/tests/test_jobs_identity.py and loaded by app/jobs/identity.py (fails closed).

pack.description: The folder name and pack id.

status.description: The Telugu words are drafts for a native reader until the owner says otherwise.

sell_style.description: products: items with photos and stock (the catalogue); services: priced services with minutes; courses: batches with a fee and seats; properties: listings; pricelist: rates by quantity.

plural_names.description: A short plural noun phrase, lower case: 'saree shops', 'clinics'. en and te are written; hi and kn are filled later (the web falls back to English).
